# Meta OpenAI: Model Fatigue Hits AI Labs

Meta, Google, OpenAI and Anthropic accelerate releases, sparking model fatigue that slows enterprise adoption amid history of AI model release cycles.

**Meta**, **Google**, **OpenAI** and **Anthropic** flood the market with new models at breakneck speed, triggering model fatigue that stalls developer uptake. History of AI model release cycles shows this pace now collides with enterprise reality, where rapid LLM iterations on enterprise adoption force teams to delay integration and retrain staff constantly. The AI industry impact spreads as firms question whether each update justifies the cost of constant migration.
